# Description Too Long (FAIL R4 + WARN W2 from same description)

This fixture's description is intentionally 1200 chars (over the 1024 hard cap) to
exercise R4 (description too long FAIL). It will also trip W2 (>200 advisory) — the
test asserts R4 fires; W2 firing alongside is acceptable.
